description: This file defines the 'Online' class within the Opencart\\Catalog\\Model\\Tool namespace. The class extends the base Model class from the Opencart system and includes a method 'addOnline' that adds an online customer record, updates the online customer list, and removes expired records based on a configured expiration time.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Model class responsible for tracking online customers, managing their online status, and cleaning up expired records.

methods.name: addOnline
methods.description: Adds or updates an online customer's record based on IP address, customer ID, URL, and referer. Cleans up expired online records based on the configured expiration time.
